description: Source code for Windows proxy configuration service in Chromium project, handling registry monitoring and proxy settings retrieval.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceWin
classes.description: Implements Windows-specific proxy configuration retrieval and registry change monitoring.

methods.name: GetCurrentProxyConfig
methods.description: Retrieves current proxy configuration from Windows Internet Explorer settings.

methods.name: SetFromIEConfig
methods.description: Converts IE proxy config to internal ProxyConfig format.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for proxy configuration changes.

methods.name: OnNetworkChanged
methods.description: Handles network change events to trigger proxy config refresh.

methods.name: StartWatchingRegistryForChanges
methods.description: Initializes registry watchers for proxy setting changes.

methods.name: AddKeyToWatchList
methods.description: Adds specific registry keys to monitor for changes.

methods.name: OnObjectSignaled
methods.description: Callback invoked when a monitored registry key changes.
